text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. 
Happy Valentine's.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...What is with that surprised expression?
choice_data_list:
I just thought you weren't interested in 
that kind of event...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Indeed... It is not as though I was 
eagerly awaiting it 
like a child, to be sure...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
However, I consider it a fine opportunity 
to share our daily sentiments 
and foster fellowship with my peers and 
classmates.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I began preparing several days in 
advance. 
—Naturally, I have something for you as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Please, accept this.
choice_data_list: Wow, thank you! May I open it?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Yes, by all means.

And so, opening the parcel she gave me, 
revealed—a beautifully shaped ohagi.

Taking a bite without delay—in that 
instant, an elegant sweetness 
spread across my mouth, drawing a breath 
of admiration from me.

Even a layman like myself could tell. It 
was clear that 
it had been crafted with great care and 
time, 
using the finest red bean paste and sugar.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Good, good.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. 
You are...—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(I poured my gratitude into this 
confection. 
My disciple has surely received it.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Therefore, words... between us, they 
would merely be inelegant.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Please, take your time and enjoy.

I finish eating the ohagi Phalaenopsis 
gave me. 
After clasping my hands with a "Thank you 
for the food"-- 
I take out my return gift.
choice_data_list: Here's something from me, then. Go ahead!

And here's something from me, then. Go 
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, my. 
You prepared something as well?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Well then, let us see what is inside--

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...? What is the matter? 
Is there some sort of issue?
choice_data_list:
I'd really appreciate it if you opened it 
after you get back to your room!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? If you say so... 
I shall gratefully partake of it later.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phaleno-saaan! 
Happy Valentine's! Day!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Here, please have some chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
My, it is quite heavy... 
Did you prepare such a generous amount for 
me?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I had so many feelings 
I wanted to share with you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phaleno-san, you're always--!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're always helping me in classics 
class-- 
and thank you so much for the tea ceremony 
the other day, too! 
Next time, I promise I'll follow all the 
etiquette perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Let's keep being great friends, okay!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. 
The pleasure is mine, as always.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Here is some nerikiri I made myself~ 
I kept the sweetness subtle, so it should 
be easy to enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I consider you one of the few friends 
with whom I can truly discuss the martial 
arts. 
I look forward to our continued 
friendship.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the feeling is mutual. 
Let us spar again sometime.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Please, take this! 
It's El's special hot-sauce-filled 
chocolate!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Let's go watch a lucha match together 
again! 
I want to hear your commentary from a 
martial artist's perspective, Phaleno!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Of course. When the opportunity arises, 
let us go once more.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I shall grant you the privilege 
of partaking in King's special chocolate, 
Phaleno-san!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Be sure to invite me to the poetry 
gathering again. Next time, 
I shall compose another first-rate waka 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Very well. 
I look forward to your verse.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Phaleno-chan. Here you go~ 
Though I just bought it at the school 
store.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Once you take this, you've gotta play 
shogi 
with me again, okay~? By the way, 
our record's tied fifty-fifty! Getting 
pretty heated, huh!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Really? If I recall, you are leading 
six to four... 
Were you trying to catch me off guard? 
Heh, I will not fall for your tricks.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Phaleno-chan! Here, take this! 
It's Tsuyoshi-brand healthy chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Thank you for always being so good to me!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Let's make health drinks together again 
sometime! 
With a conditioning pro like you, 
Phaleno-chan, 
I know we can make an even stronger drink 
next time!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, very well. 
We shall find an occasion for that before 
long.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...Everyone not only gave me chocolate, 
but also voiced their gratitude as they 
handed it over.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Truly, they are irreplaceable 
peers.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(It brings warmth to the heart. Having it 
put into 
words for me like this, once more... Hm?)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Looking back upon it. 
...How was that?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(I poured all my feelings of gratitude 
into the ohagi. 
Therefore...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(My Trainer understood, even without me 
exhausting words. 
Of that, I am certain.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
......It was conveyed. 
Then that should be enough.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(And yet... hmm. 
I feel somewhat... unsettled, one might 
say...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ......Well, no matter.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...Oh. True to its packaging, 
the contents inside carry an air of 
luxury...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Mm! Yes, it is delicious!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(A subtle bitterness spreads across the 
palate. An elegant 
chocolate that highlights the true flavor 
of cacao—very much to my taste.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? There appears to be something in 
the bag. 
A message card, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
("To Phalaenopsis. 
I thought giving you just chocolate would 
feel a bit cold, 
so I decided to include a little 
message.")

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for always pouring everything 
you have 
into meeting my expectations."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
"It's because you are who you are that I 
can strive 
with all my might to support you."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
"It's because you are who you are that I 
can strive 
with all my might to support you."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
"I look forward to our journey ahead. 
<username>"

The day after Valentine's Day. Sitting 
upon my desk 
was a bar of matcha-flavored chocolate.

Looking closer, a small note card was 
resting 
beside the chocolate bar. I picked it up 
and read it.

Written upon it in elegant calligraphy 
were a few brief words. 
It read—
"You have my gratitude."

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Phalaeno-chan! I'm home! 
Did you get tons of chocolates this year 
too?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Then let's have our usual chocolate party! 
Wait right there! I'll go brew some tea!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...My apologies, Big-dono.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...An urgent matter has suddenly arisen.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very muuch~ 
Please come again~

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...I must make haste.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The lights are... Good. 
They are still on.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Even without uttering a single word, my 
gratitude— 
it surely reached Trainer. Of that, I have 
no doubt.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: (Yet, even knowing that—)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —I wish to speak it myself.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(The instant I read that note, the first 
gale of spring blew through me. 
A quiet joy enveloped my very being.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(If, by putting it into words, I might 
truly 
summon such a wind for them, then—)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Trainer.
choice_data_list:
...Phalaeno? What are you doing here this 
late?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Take this.

With those words, she handed me 
a bar of matcha-flavored chocolate.
choice_data_list:
...A chocolate bar? Even though you 
already gave me ohagi?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Forgive me for such an impromptu offering.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet along with it— 
allow me to say it once more.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: You are truly worthy of praise.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Your unwavering devotion, your earnest 
heart. 
Countless times have they sustained me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Only because you are here do I stand as I 
am today. 
And only then can the me of tomorrow seize 
my grand ambition.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Therefore... please accept this.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ——You have my deepest gratitude.
